description:
Derive `Display` and `Error` for the artifact-plan error types, matching the crate's error convention.

## Background

`PlanError` hand-writes `Display` and `Error` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_plan.rs:1113-1187`), and so does its sibling `InventoryError` (`domain/artifact_inventory.rs:136`). The crate's convention is `thiserror` derives (about 100 in the crate); `artifact_discovery.rs:207` and `repository_state/archive.rs:547` already wrap `PlanError` with `#[from]`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `PlanError` and `InventoryError` derive `thiserror::Error`, and their hand-written `Display` and `Error` impls are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each error message is unchanged, as the existing tests observe.
title: Artifact-plan errors use the derive-based error convention
